title: 1990 AHSME Problem 25
statement: Nine congruent spheres are packed inside a unit cube in such a way that one of them has its center at the center of the cube and each of the others is tangent to the center sphere and to three faces of the cube. What is the radius of each sphere?

solutions.text:
If the radius is \(r,\) a corner sphere has center \((r,r,r)\) and the central sphere has center \((\frac{1}{2},\frac{1}{2},\frac{1}{2}).\) Tangency gives \[ \sqrt3\left(\frac12-r\right)=2r. \] Solving and rationalizing, \[ r=\frac{\sqrt3}{2(2+\sqrt3)} =\frac{2\sqrt3-3}{2}. \]

Thus the correct answer is B.
hints: Place one corner sphere’s center at \((r,r,r)\)
